summaries.en: As the deadline set by President Trump approaches, the US and Iran are reportedly reviewing a 'two-week ceasefire plan' proposed by Pakistan, leading to a surge in the possibility of a last-minute diplomatic resolution.
summaries.zh: 在特朗普总统设定的最后期限临近之际，美国和伊朗据报正在各自审查巴基斯坦提出的“两周停火方案”，这使得最后一刻通过外交途径解决危机的可能性急剧上升。
